title: Subset Selecting
statement: The task is to form disjoint groups of array elements, each with at least k elements, maximising the mex of the group maxima, with n up to 100 and values in 0..n. Reaching mex M needs, for every v < M, a group whose maximum is exactly v. This gives a greedy prefix-count check: every v below M must be present and at least (v+1)k elements must be <= v.
